card.name: Words before tissue layers in procedures
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the', 'of', 'to' or the start of 'sub' just before an expected body-tissue layer or membrane name (peritoneum, subcutaneous, subarachnoid, skin) in surgical or injection instructions.

modes.label: Linking word before a layer
modes.description: 'the' or 'of' after closure/insert, right before a named tissue layer.

modes.label: Start of sub- words
modes.description: 'sub' beginning words like subcutaneous or subarachnoid.

modes.label: Placement wording near skin
modes.description: Words in insertion directions that lead into a skin or chamber location.
